description: Failure cases from the second completed Lab 03 COST run; numerical examples are fixture data, not issuer rules.
false_comparison: The operating margin exceeds the margins reported by peer companies BJ's Wholesale Club, Target, and Walmart, whose operating margins are provided by the peer calculations.
false_segments: The business is organized into three primary segments: core merchandise categories, warehouse ancillary services, and other businesses.
categories: We offer merchandise and services in the following categories: core merchandise categories, warehouse ancillary services, and other businesses.
segments: Our operating models are generally the same across our U.S., Canadian, and Other International operating segments.
contribution: Higher gasoline prices positively impacted net sales. Changes in foreign currencies positively impacted net sales.
point_in_time: Digitally-enabled comparable sales increased during the fiscal year.
false_price_claim: Revenue growth indicates expanding top-line without reliance on price hikes.
false_acceleration: Digitally-enabled comparable sales are accelerating, reflecting stronger e-commerce adoption across markets.
false_causality: Continued opening of new warehouses expands the store footprint and drives comparable sales growth.
false_missing: Quarterly cash-flow from operations is not provided in the current evidence set; acquiring the detailed 10-Q cash-flow statement would be necessary.
ratio_review: Claims such as operating margin exceeding peers, revenue growth, and free cash flow rely solely on calculated metrics without accompanying narrative evidence from the filing.
limitation_review: Limitations are listed separately as bullet points rather than integrated into qualitative prose with appropriate citations.
recommendation_review: The recommendation relies on a single deciding metric (revenue growth) without explicitly linking other supporting metrics in the prose.
